title: Sexual crosses of Zymoseptoria tritici
author: Marcello Zala
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s22egge

steps.title: Prepare Susceptible Wheat Plants
steps.instruction: Sow 50-60 seeds of a susceptible wheat variety into plastic pots (e.g., 22x18x17cm) and grow under specific greenhouse conditions until the third leaf is well developed.

substeps.instruction: Maintain greenhouse conditions: 16 h light (6:00–22:00), 8 h dark (22:00–6:00), temperature 18°C day/15°C night, and 70% humidity.
Wait 2 to 3 weeks (typically 14 to 21 days, or day 17 after sowing) until the third leaf is developed.

steps.title: Prepare Z. tritici Liquid Inoculum
steps.instruction: Cultivate the desired Z. tritici strains (with contrary mating types) in YSB liquid media.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 50 mL YSB liquid media (in a 100 mL Erlenmeyer flask) amended with 50 µg/mL kanamycin using 30-50 µl of spores from -80°C stock (or spores produced on YMA plates).
Shake the flask at 120-140 rpm for 5 to 7 days at 18°C.

steps.title: Prepare Spore Suspension
steps.instruction: Concentrate and standardize the spore suspension for inoculation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer inoculum from the Erlenmeyer flask to a 50 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge at 3750 rpm for 10-15 min.
Gently decant the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 20 to 30 mL water.
Vortex and count spores using a Thoma chamber.
Prepare a total of 60 to 100 mL mixed spore suspension, with each strain at a concentration of 10^6 cells ml^-1.
Add 0.05% TWEEN20 to the solution (e.g., 50 µl per 100 mL spore solution).

steps.title: Inoculate Wheat Plants
steps.instruction: Apply the spore suspension to the plants and maintain high humidity for incubation.

substeps.instruction: Water the soil well before spraying to ensure good humidity.
Inoculate plants by spraying the suspension until 'run off' using a cosmetic sprayer.
Cover pots with a plastic bag to ensure 100% humidity.
Incubate for 48-72 h, then remove the plastic bags.

steps.title: Induce Pseudothecia Maturation
steps.instruction: Promote the development and release of ascospores by moving plants to outdoor conditions.

substeps.instruction: Wait 2-3 weeks in the greenhouse until pycnidia are visible.
Transfer pots outside the greenhouse to spring or fall weather conditions.
Cover pots and plants with a net (e.g., cheesecloth) and water the soil regularly.
Alternatively, lay infected leaves on the soil when pycnidia become visible and water frequently (every 2-3 days) for 3-5 weeks.
Monitor for the release of ascospores every week starting 2-3 weeks after moving outdoors; note that leaves must start to degrade for pseudothecia to mature.
